description: This file is a shell script for testing various functionalities related to Git references and replacements, including commit modifications, grafts, replacement object handling, and other Git operations on a repository. It defines functions for setting up test environments, processes, and expected behaviors for Git commands in a test suite.

methods.name: add_and_commit_file
methods.description: Adds a file to Git, runs test_tick, then commits with a message.

methods.name: commit_buffer_contains_parents
methods.description: Verifies the commit's parent references match expected parents.

methods.name: commit_peeling_shows_parents
methods.description: Checks that peeling a commit shows its parent commits correctly.

methods.name: commit_has_parents
methods.description: Runs both parent verification functions to confirm commit's parents.
